text: Old Odo asked about the rows even when he was dying, friend. Next, we need to get the stew ready.

context.speaker: Ana
speaker_knows: Old Odo died in the rice field this morning; I held his hand and he asked whether the rows were straight.
Hale was shot dead at the barricade and Tam saw it from the door.
Bram took the spare rifle at night and thinks nobody saw.

text: He was tough, my brother, tough.

context.speaker: Dee

text: Mara, my sustenance, I promise always to share the best portion of the day with you.

context.speaker: Cy

text: I pledge my life to you, Cy, through all the shifting winds and the quiet years.
